description: Nominal room-temperature screening-tier properties of structural and high-conductivity metals: elasticity, thermal expansion and conduction, density, strain-life fatigue constants and Larson-Miller creep-rupture master curves. Data only; physics modules take these values as explicit inputs.

references.steinberg1996: Steinberg, D. J. (1996). Equation of State and Strength Properties of Selected Materials. Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory Report UCRL-MA-106439 Change 1 (nominal room-temperature E, alpha, nu).
references.nist_sp960: NIST Structural Materials Database (SP-960): temperature-dependent moduli for Inconel 718 and tantalum-tungsten alloys.
references.simo_halford2001: Simo, J. J.; Halford, G. R. (2001). NASA/TP-2001-210453, GRCop-84 copper alloy characterization (E, alpha and low-cycle-fatigue constants of the high-conductivity copper-alloy family GRCop-84, CuCrZr and NARloy-Z).
references.special_metals_smc045: Special Metals Corp. (2007). Inconel 718 datasheet, publication SMC-045 (E, alpha, nu, fatigue strength coefficient).
references.buckman2000: Buckman, R. W. Jr. (2000). New Applications for Tantalum and Tantalum Alloys. JOM 52(3): 40-41 (Ta-10W properties).
references.larson_miller1952: Larson, F. R.; Miller, J. (1952). Trans. ASME 74: 765-775 (Larson-Miller constant C ~ 20 for most engineering alloys).
references.iter_mddd2013: ITER Organization (2013). Materials Design Description Document (MDDD), IDM reference 22F2ES (nominal room-temperature E, yield strength, k and alpha of pure tungsten and CuCrZr).
references.iaea_tecdoc1668: IAEA (2011). IAEA-TECDOC-1668, Structural Materials for Liquid Metal Cooled Fast Reactor Fuel Assemblies - Operational Behaviour (316L austenitic stainless steel property compilation).
references.iaea_tecdoc1830: IAEA (2018). IAEA-TECDOC-1830, Advances in Small Modular Reactor Technology Developments (EUROFER-97 property compilation; maximum service temperature set by thermal creep onset).
references.tavassoli2002: Tavassoli, A.-A. F. et al. (2002). Materials Design Data for Reduced Activation Martensitic Steel Type EUROFER. J. Nucl. Mater. 307-311: 300-307 (EUROFER-97 fatigue and creep constants).

creep_rupture.note: Illustrative screening-tier master-curve fit; replace with the material's certified rupture data for intermediate or high fidelity.

provenance.statement: Nominal room-temperature screening values from the listed references; temperature dependence is not represented and must be supplied from the cited curves for higher-fidelity use.
